project_type: VS Code extension (TypeScript), esbuild bundles: node cjs host bundle + browser iife webview scripts; vitest unit tests with a vscode stub; no HTML parser dependency (own tokenizer in src/core/htmlTokens.ts)
language: TypeScript 5.9 (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, noImplicitOverride, module Node16, lib ES2022+DOM)
build_system: npm scripts: build = node esbuild.mjs (configs: src/extension.ts -> dist/extension.js; src/webview/search.ts -> media/search.js). media/*.js are generated and gitignored; media/*.css tracked. Exact-version pinned devDependencies; do NOT add dependencies.
test_framework: vitest 3 (test/unit/**/*.test.ts only, `vscode` aliased to test/unit/vscodeStub.ts), fast-check 4 for properties in test/unit/properties/. Integration tests (vscode-test) are not runnable here.
test_command: npm run typecheck ; npm test   (single file: npx vitest --run test/unit/<name>.test.ts)
verification_instructions: From d:\CODING\AIWorks\goget-manager: 1) npm run typecheck 2) npm test 3) npm run build 4) npx vsce ls (FEAT-003: must list media/detail.css and media/detail.js and not sample-pages/ or .agents/). Opt-in live test (FEAT-001): $env:GOGET_LIVE='1'; npx vitest --run test/unit/detailLive.test.ts. Do not run npm run test:integration (downloads VS Code).
snapshot_or_generated_files: media/search.js and media/detail.js are generated by `npm run build` and gitignored (never commit them). dist/ is gitignored. goget-manager-0.0.1.vsix is gitignored.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell (use `;` not `&&` in PowerShell 5; use $env:VAR for env vars). Workspace root d:\CODING\AIWorks\goget-manager is the git worktree on branch main: create and switch to branch feat/detail-tab before the first commit if still on main. sample-pages/ is untracked reference material: never `git add` it and never make tests depend on it (copy trimmed fixtures into test/fixtures/package-detail/). .agents/ holds workflow artifacts: never `git add` it. Stage files by explicit path, commit locally, NEVER push. Never run destructive git commands.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/steering files exist. Follow existing conventions: src/core is pure (no vscode import, injected deps), src/vscode is the vscode layer, src/webview are browser scripts; webview DOM built with textContent/DomLike, no markup from strings except the single sanitized innerHTML in the detail main section; strict CSP with nonce; messages from webviews validated by a never-throwing parse function; user-facing strings in src/core/messages.ts; unit tests for every new module; commit messages in Conventional Commits style (e.g. `feat: ...`).
key_patterns: Scraper style: src/core/resultsParser.ts (SELECTORS table, never throws, tolerant) built on src/core/htmlTokens.ts tokenizeHtml. HTTP: src/vscode/searchClient.ts PkgGoDevSearchClient.search(url, signal) (generic pkg.go.dev-only GET, implements SearchClient from src/core/searchController.ts; reuse it, do not use global fetch). Controller style: src/core/searchController.ts (deps interface, TimerApi from debouncer.ts, generation counter for stale responses, AbortController, OutputLike logging, listeners Set, dispose). Provider/HTML builder style: src/vscode/searchViewProvider.ts (buildSearchHtml pure function, randomBytes nonce, localResourceRoots media, post via Promise.resolve(webview.postMessage(m)).catch). Webview style: src/webview/search.ts + render.ts (DomLike, acquireVsCodeApi, ready handshake). Installed detection: src/core/installedMatch.ts isInstalledPackage/collectInstalledModulePaths, wired in src/extension.ts via InstalledModulesSource {onDidChange: repository.onDidChange, modules()}. Protocol validation: src/core/searchProtocol.ts parseWebviewMessage. Test styles: test/unit/searchViewProvider.test.ts (FakeWebviewView), test/unit/render.test.ts (fake DOM), test/unit/searchController.test.ts + searchArbitraries.ts (controller harness with fake timers: test/unit/fakeTimers.ts), properties/*.test.ts (fast-check).
directory_structure: src/core = pure logic; src/vscode = vscode layer; src/webview = browser scripts bundled to media/*.js; media/ = css (tracked) + generated js; test/unit = vitest tests (+ properties/, fixtures in test/fixtures/); .agents/tasks = plans/reviews/FEAT artifacts; sample-pages = untracked saved pkg.go.dev pages (package_detail.html is github.com/pkg/sftp/v2?GOOS=windows).
